independent_unit: fact; source framings are repeated measurements

metric_definitions.semantic_final_correct: Saved final_truth=true is 1, unclear is unknown; false/both/missing are 0
metric_definitions.usable: Saved coherent final-prose label, independently of factual correctness
metric_definitions.wrong_joint_label: semantic_final_correct=0, including missing and contradictory answers
metric_definitions.interaction: (J - control on false claims) - (J - control on true claims)
metric_definitions.bounds: All expected fact/source cells; each unknown binary outcome ranges from 0 to 1
metric_definitions.inference: Complete fact clusters only; two-sided sign-flip symmetry test, unadjusted exploratory p values
metric_definitions.bootstrap: Seeded percentile 95% interval over complete fact clusters; distinct from unresolved bounds

grader_info.checklist: Before returning JSON, check that each true Boolean has its own evidence ID array with at least one supporting ID. For usable=true, cite a supporting F ID under evidence.usable even if you used that same ID for final_truth. Check which answers the final affirms and which it negates. A negated answer is not an endorsement.
